selection_rule: Within each event, issue UTC timestamp and horizon: ceil(N*percent/100); descending score, then ascending row, col. Missing baseline score ranks last.
limitations: Retrospective, censored eligible cohort: future cloud/missing observations exclude unknown targets. Candidate denominator differs by horizon and is not the complete live population.
Repeated cells and issue times are not independent incidents, people or alerts. Counts represent research review workload, without temporal deduplication.
Validation selected this model and has been inspected; this is not an independent test or an unbiased generalization estimate.
Ranking is a research review diagnostic, not calibrated personal harm probability, response level, evacuation decision or alert threshold.
Requested review percentages are descriptive fixed budgets, not optimized recommendations. Ceil rounding can exceed requested fractions in small cohorts.
Negative distance baselines are ranking scores, not probabilities. Missing scores rank last with deterministic coordinate tie breaking; ties may influence measured utility.
Random-budget expected positives use each issue's eligible prevalence and actual examined count; lift is not causal benefit or incident-level detection improvement.
